description:
Storage buckets of a database: list and create — without a secret key.

    Files must be enabled for the database. A private bucket opens nothing by
    itself: reading and uploading are decided by storage policies (the
    dashboard → Files → Policies, or SQL on storage.objects). Creating needs
    the person's consent. Needs a token with the admin scope — the storage key
    is issued only to it, even for listing.

action.description: `list` — the database's storage buckets; `create` — a new bucket.
action.title: Action

allowed_mime_types.description: For create: allowed MIME types, e.g. ["image/jpeg", "image/png"].
allowed_mime_types.title: Allowed Mime Types

confirmed.description: true — the person has already agreed in the chat after seeing what will change. A client with forms does not need it: the server asks the person itself. Never set it without the person's explicit consent.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

database.description: The database: name, slug or id. Without it — the organization's only database with the Data API enabled.
database.title: Database

max_size_bytes.description: For create: file size limit in bytes.
max_size_bytes.title: Max Size Bytes

organization.description: Organization slug. Without it — the only one, or the personal one.
organization.title: Organization

public.description: For create: anyone with the link can download files. Default false — who reads and uploads is decided by storage policies.
public.title: Public

name: data_api_buckets
title: Data API базы: бакеты файлов
